scientific_integrity: The all-order statements rely on the written combinatorial and matrix-tree proofs; the standalone direct graph enumerations are corroboration only. Earlier degree-constrained rook-graph tree-count kernels are acknowledged. Unindexed earlier work remains a priority risk.
scientific_limitations: The full-edge-subdivision correspondence requires a connected simple base graph of order at least three; no polynomial-time evaluation bound for the general sum is claimed. Counts use labeled vertex subsets. The complete-bipartite formula assumes both shore sizes at least two.
title: Minimal connected domination of full edge subdivisions: a tree-cover correspondence and sparse cardinality spectra
